about: A consumer that refuses every handoff as edited: every check that must accept, and every one that must name another rule, fails.

mutations.find: export const consumeFinding = (c) => ((r) => (r ? { rule: r.rule, say: r.say(c) } : null))(CONSUME_RULES.find((x) => x.fails(c)));
mutations.replace: export const consumeFinding = () => ({ rule: "HOF_DIGEST", say: "every handoff is refused" });
